company.name: Peacock
company.shortDescription: NBC and Bravo shows, movies, and live sports from NBC in the United States.
company.planHelp: On a computer go to peacocktv.com, sign in, click your profile picture in the top right corner and choose Account. Your plan – Select, Premium or Premium Plus – is shown under Plans. In the Peacock app, go to the gear or profile icon, then Account, then Plans.

sources.title: How much does a Peacock subscription cost? – Peacock Help
How many streams can I view concurrently on Peacock?

features.label: No advertisements
features.question: Do you want to watch without advertisements?
features.help: Only the most expensive plan removes advertisements, and even then live sports and live channels still carry them.

features.label: Save shows to watch without internet
features.question: Do you save shows onto a phone or tablet to watch where there is no internet?
features.help: Only the most expensive Peacock plan allows this.

features.label: Live sports and big events
features.question: Do you want live sports and big live events?
features.help: The cheapest Peacock plan leaves out sports, movies and Peacock's own new series.

features.label: Movies and Peacock's own series
features.question: Do you want movies and the new series Peacock makes itself?
features.help: The cheapest plan only has ordinary television shows from NBC, Bravo and similar channels.

features.label: People who can watch at the same time
features.question: How many people watch at the same time?
features.help: Peacock allows three at once on every plan.

plans.name: Peacock Select
plans.bestFor: People who only want everyday NBC and Bravo shows and do not care about sport or movies.
plans.notes: A cut-down plan. Peacock's own plan page states it does not include sports, movies or Peacock's own new series, and it shows advertisements.

plans.name: Peacock Premium
plans.bestFor: Most people – it has the sports, the movies and the new series, and it is the usual choice.
plans.notes: Includes live sports and events, movies and Peacock's own series, but shows advertisements. Paying yearly saves about two months' worth compared with paying monthly.

plans.name: Peacock Premium Plus
plans.bestFor: People who watch Peacock often and are tired of the advertisements, or who want shows saved for journeys.
plans.notes: No advertisements apart from some exceptions: advertisements remain in live channels, live sports and events, and a few shows and movies. Allows saving shows to watch without internet.

faq.q: Does the most expensive plan really have no advertisements?
faq.a: Almost. Peacock says advertisements still appear in its live channels, in live sports and events, and in a few shows and movies, because of the deals behind them.

faq.q: What does the cheapest Select plan leave out?
faq.a: It leaves out sports, movies and the new series Peacock makes itself. You get everyday television shows from NBC, Bravo and similar channels.

faq.q: Is it cheaper to pay for a year?
faq.a: Yes. Each plan has a yearly price that works out at about ten months' worth instead of twelve.

faq.q: How many people can watch at once?
faq.a: Three devices at the same time, on every plan.

notes: Prices exclude tax. Peacock also sells a student offer at 6.99 per month for twelve months and a bundle with Apple TV starting at 17.99 per month; both are promotional or bundled and are not modelled as plans. Peacock's free tier no longer appears on the current plan page, so it is not included.
